items.title: How IBM scales post-acquisition cloud migrations with Targetprocess
items.summary: At IBM, post-acquisition cloud migration is a continuous, repeatable process built on IBM Targetprocess. Every acquisition brings its own infrastructure, identity systems, billing structures, and operational practices. Integrating a new company into a cloud estate quickly, securely, and without disrupting customers is a complex process for a single acquisition and becomes increasingly complex at scale. […]
